text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of Members of Council to the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors.

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Members to the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors for a term starting July 1, 2019, and ending December 31, 2020 and until successors are appointed: Councillor Brad Bradford Councillor Cynthia Lai
